label: first copy-phase step (recall_idx 1) when the fed-back input is c (first original token c), long sequences L>=6
explanation: Fires only at step L+1, i.e. the first copy step after <DEL>, where the input is the model own first output, and almost exclusively when that input is c (so first_tok == c; 99.9% of mass). It is also gated by sequence length: silent for L<=5, weak and only ~61% reliable at L=6 (2% of mass), and reliable with growing magnitude for L=7,8,9 (L=9 holds 45% of mass; top examples are all L=9). Never fires in the original phase, on the delimiter, or at any later copy step, and does not fire on c inputs anywhere else. Rare tiny activations at step L+1 with other first tokens (q, 2, o, d) carry about 0.1% of mass. Magnitude is set by L; the output token and the later tokens have little effect.

issues: Test scores reproduce: precision 0.898, recall 0.982, F1 0.938, mass recall 0.999.

All 1152 false positives on the test split are L=6, step 7 (c at recall_idx 1). This matches the stated partial gating at L=6. On dev, the L=6 slice has precision 0.59 and holds 2.3% of mass, which matches the stated ~61% and 2%.

No simple variable cleanly separates firing from silence at L=6. Weak modulators: n_digits>=2 gives precision 0.72, a digit at out_tok gives 0.69, in_count>=2 gives 0.42, and a third original token of c (next_out==c) almost completely suppresses it (1%, n=75). That suppression does not hold for L>=7, where precision is 1.0. These look like graded near-threshold effects, not a missing concept class.

All 181 missed activations on the test split are tiny (relative activation <=0.04) at step 10 (L=9, recall_idx 1) with first tokens other than c. Together they hold 0.1% of mass, as the explanation says.

The other factual claims check out: the feature is silent in the original phase, on the delimiter, at recall_idx>=2, and for L<=5. Mass shares by L are 0.023, 0.197, 0.332 and 0.448, so it grows with L. L>=7 gives test precision 1.0, recall 0.82, F1 0.90.
The label matches the predicate. Because the model copies correctly here, in_tok==c at recall_idx 1 is the same as first_tok==c.
